title: Extension of scalars is left adjoint to restriction
statement:
Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $M$ an $R$-module and $N$ an $S$-module, regarded as an $R$-module through $\varphi$; let $S\otimes_RM$ be the base change of $M$ [def-weil-module-base-change] (written with $S$ on the left). Then the map
$$\operatorname{Hom}_S(S\otimes_RM,N)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_R(M,N),\qquad\psi\longmapsto(m\mapsto\psi(1\otimes m))$$
is bijective, with inverse $\lambda\mapsto(s\otimes m\mapsto s\,\lambda(m))$, and natural in $N$: for an $S$-linear $\beta:N\to N'$ it carries $\beta\circ\psi$ to $\beta\circ(m\mapsto\psi(1\otimes m))$. (Stacks, Algebra, Lemma 05DQ.)
